flags.komets_friend: set: act1 (spared/fed Komets after the chase) or act2 sewer (forgave him after the ambush; clears komets_betrayed). used: act2 square confession (ראיות) + sewer route to the archive; act4 steals Tadrik's master-pick (boss aid); true ending requirement
flags.komets_betrayed: set: act1 (handed Komets to the watch or beat him). used: act2 Komets leads Sarna's cutthroats to you (ambush); act4 Komets absent, no boss aid
flags.irna_trust: set: act1 (surrendered and told the truth), act2 route 150 (reported back), or act3 (convinced her with ראיות >= 3). used: act3 Irna (the Iron Mask) shields you and leads to exit 300; act4 stops the White Mask; with item 'תג המשמר' the watch arrives (boss bypass); win ending 381
flags.lied_to_irna: set: act1 interrogation lie. used: act3 Irna exposes you at the ball (חשד +2); act4 watch bypass unavailable
flags.sarna_deal: set: act1 (passed the guild test) or act2 (joined at the rooftop court). used: act2 fence prices/den access; act4 Sarna's crew opens the outer gate on route 340, then Sarna betrays you at the Key unless you hold 'פנקס החובות'
flags.olbena_ally: set: act2 (solved the bottle test honestly or protected the lab from inspectors). used: act3 her antidote saves you from the poisoned wine; act4 mage-only formula unmakes the clockwork guardian
flags.stole_from_olbena: set: act2 (stole from her shelves). used: act3 Olbena recognizes you at the ball and points you out (חשד +2)
flags.grom_champion: set: act2 (won the pit tournament final). used: act3 Grom brings you in as a bodyguard (entry 250 option); act4 pit fighters hold the stair on route 340 (skip sentries combat)
flags.knows_homunculus: set: act2 (the corpse is clay: Olbena's lab or the watch morgue). used: act3 argument to Irna / council (ראיות); act4 reveal dialogue + true ending requirement
flags.fed_cat: set: act1 (fed/petted the three-legged cat 'בריח' in the Locksmith Hall). used: act3 the cat leads you to the Silent Doors shortcut; act4 cameo in endings
flags.carved_bell: set: act1 (carved your mark on the bell of the Rooftop Tower). used: act4 the bell rings at the right moment and distracts the vault sentries (skip a check)
flags.silent_doors_seen: set: act3 (found the Silent Doors corridor in the palace). used: act4 option to open the Silent Doors with the Key; true ending requirement
flags.council_marked: set: act3 (drew the White Mask's attention). used: act4 route 300 adds an extra sentry combat

items.תיבה נעולה: start_effects. act1: opens by itself in the Locksmith Hall and is replaced by 'מפתח-פגיון'
items.מפתח-פגיון: act1 (from the casket; story weapon +2). act2: tested at Olbena's lab or the morgue: pig's blood (ראיות +1). act3: if discarded, Zimri 'finds' it and returns it (רמזים +1). act4: fits the maker's keyhole of the outer vault gate
items.רסיס חומר: act1 (examined the body; mage gets it automatically). act2: identified at Olbena's lab -> knows_homunculus, ראיות +1
items.משרוקית פח: act1 (Zimri gives it at the gate). act3: whistle with the orchestra (easter egg, רמזים +1). act4: the guild tune halts the clockwork guardian (combat bypass)
items.פנקס החובות: act2 (stolen or won at Dolisa's den / Sarna's office). ראיות +1 when read (payments signed 'ז.'). act4: blackmail Sarna to prevent her betrayal
items.מסכת נשף: act2 (bought, won or stolen). act3: required for the guests' gate (entry 200)
items.הזמנה מוזהבת: act2 (won at the den or from Irna on route 150). act3: audience with the White Mask; with מסכת נשף goes to entry 200
items.אבקת חלודה: act2 (Olbena's shop or gift). act4: rusts the sewer grate on route 340 and weakens Tadrik's lock-mail (boss aid)
items.שמן שקט: act2 (Olbena's shop, or stolen from her shelves). act4: passes the Hall of Listening Locks without a check
items.תג המשמר: act1 (Irna gives it on the surrender route) or act2 route 150. act3: pass a palace guard checkpoint. act4: with irna_trust summons the watch (boss bypass)
items.תרשים הכספת: act2 (Locksmith Archive) or act3 (from Zimri, רמזים +1). act4: choose the right corridor without a check
items.טביעת שעווה: act3 (wax impression of the Key at the display). act4 beat 1: forged into 'מפתח מזויף'
items.מפתח מזויף: act4 (forged from 'טביעת שעווה'). act4: swap with the real Key; boss bypass
items.חרב הבור: act2 (pit tournament prize; story weapon +3). combat only
items.גלימת גגות: act1 (Sarna's guild gift on passing the test). story armor +1
items.חבל: act1 (Sarna's fence) / act2 (pit armory). act1 Widow's Gap and the wall; act3 climb down from the dome; act4 the shaft on route 340

counters.חשד: how much the city believes you are the murderer, 0-10. start 0 (start_effects); act1 set to 3 when framed; +1/+2 for visible actions, -1/-2 for alibis and evidence shown. act2/act3 hub redirects: >=8 arrest scene; act3 >=10 -> bad ending 293
counters.לילות: nights passed. start 1 (start_effects). +1 at each act2 entry, +1 at each act3 entry; act2 optional 'spend another night' +1. act4 entries: <=3 before the Sealing (quiet), >=4 during the Sealing (council in the vault, extra combat)
counters.ראיות: evidence of your innocence, 0-7. act2: Komets' confession, clay shard, pig's blood, ledger, Grom's testimony, the archive door-log; act3: overheard White Mask; act4: the Key's memory (+1 automatic, +1 more for mage). act3 >=3 convinces Irna; win endings need >=3, true needs >=5
counters.רמזים: clues that the beggar Zimri is Tadrik, 0-6. act1: generosity to Zimri / thief reads maker-mark on the casket; act2: guild whistle in the archive, the ledger; act3: servant without blindfold, the returned dagger or the map note, the orchestra; act4: the gate, the guardian, 'name him'. act4: >=2 unlocks 'name him', >=3 is a boss aid
counters.בעלי ברית: allies won, 0-5: +1 when setting komets_friend, irna_trust, sarna_deal, olbena_ally, grom_champion. act4 route 340: >=3 unlocks the allies' assault
